body: A per-disk key (SSEKMSKeyID) already covered one-disk-per-tenant. For one client/bucket shared by tenants under scoped disks, the driver gets a pure func(driverKey) string resolver (decide by prefix, no I/O, no ctx) because a scoped disk's prefix reaches the driver in the key; RequestOptions.SSEKMSKeyID overrides one call. Precedence call > resolver > SSEKMSKeyID; same SSE rules (KMS or empty SSE, never AES256/SSE-C). Resolved once in writeSettings so every write path (put, transfer manager, copy, multipart, presigned PUT, presigned POST) uses the same value.
title: S3 per-tenant SSE-KMS via Config.SSEKMSKeyFor(key) resolver plus RequestOptions.SSEKMSKeyID
